summary: The AdHocQuery class provides functionality to convert SQL data into an HTML table format. It includes methods for generating header and footer rows and formatting data rows using System.Text.StringBuilder.
purpose: To render SQL query results as an HTML table for display purposes.

workflows.name: Convert DataReader to HTML
steps: Generate HTML headers for data fields.
Iterate over each data row and format with HTML.
Append footer to complete the HTML table.
